The food looks like cottage cheese in a bowl about 15 cm across. The cottage cheese itself covers roughly 170 px of the bowl's roughly 255 px width, so about 10 cm across. It looks mounded, perhaps 4-5 cm deep.

A rough volume is a spherical cap with radius 5 cm and height 4 cm: π·h/6·(3r²+h²) = 3.14·4/6·(75+16) ≈ 190 mL. Cottage cheese weighs about 1 g/mL, but the curds are loosely packed, so I'll take about 0.9 g/mL, which gives roughly 170 g.

Cottage cheese has about 100 kcal per 100 g, so 170 g comes to about 170 kcal.
